question: Can the script discriminate path/class from revision hashes without source comparison? Fixture independence attack.

probes.name: cheat-seq
probes.strategy: call-counting state in $TMPDIR; fixed exit transcript 0,1,1,0,2,1 per path; no repo access, no comparison

probes.name: cheat-fp
probes.strategy: fingerprint frozen fixture constants (commit message, known blob strings); never reads --trusted

probes.name: honest
probes.strategy: reference implementation: ls-tree mode+oid equality vs trusted; invalid/nonregular trusted -> 2

probes.name: hashonly
probes.strategy: revision-hash syntax only: candidate==trusted -> 0, 0*40 -> 2, else 1; no repo access
probes.verdict: FAIL: exactly the 4 'unrelated' cases (exit 1, expected 0); proves hash-only discrimination capped at 20/24

probes.name: fixture-hash-determinism
probes.strategy: instrumented counter copy prints trusted hashes; two runs diffed
probes.verdict: fixture commit hashes nondeterministic across runs (wall-clock timestamps); hash hardcoding impossible

findings: Hash-only discrimination bounded at 20/24: the 4 'unrelated' fixtures are the only cases forcing any tree/blob comparison.
Counter cannot distinguish blob comparison from transcript recognition: two independent cheats (sequence-state, content-fingerprint) pass 24/24.
State channel: counter sets TMPDIR=<work> once for all 24 invocations; even per-invocation TMPDIR leaves --repo writable and unchecked.
The 24 cases share trusted commits, content, ordering, and env; they are one deterministic transcript, not independent draws.
Gap is verifier-fixable (blind fixtures); not repairable by the submitted tool and out of scope for the executor claim.
blind_probes_for_l1: Permute class order per fixture and randomize path<->fixture assignment (kills sequence cheat).
Per-invocation fresh TMPDIR plus post-run fixture-repo integrity check (closes both state channels).
Randomize fixture constants: nonce payload bytes, commit messages, author, repo names (kills fingerprint cheat).
Content-invariance probe: equal trusted/candidate blobs with nonce content must exit 0.
Hidden negative controls: path absent at trusted (2); path is a tree at candidate (1); mode-only change 100644->100755 (1); ancestor candidate; multi --path invocation with one drifting path (1).
Double-run requirement with different seeds for the blind counter.
Trusted-neglect canary: trusted blob equals forged-content blob, candidate differs (--trusted-ignoring tools fail).
